Name: Lucikiel for Mobile Phone (And Mobile Phone Continued)
Author: ShatteredEffect
Description:
[b]NOTE[/b]: This mod has been updated to 1.6. There are now versions for BOTH Mobile Phone Continued by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url] and Mobile Phone by Aedenthorn! ONLY DOWNLOAD ONE FILE, matching whichever of the Mobile Phone Versions you have. 

This Mod adds Lucikiel's events to the phone, and makes his dialogue when answering and saying goodbye on the phone more unique (this does not change his in game dialogue).

I would like to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92469153]Arknir27[/url] for the creation and building of our sassy demon, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for making this all possible through their Mobile Phone mod. (Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for helping me figure out some kinks that I was having in the code!)

[b]You can find all the required mods here
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307 ]Lucikiel [/url]by Arknir27

[b]NOTE: DOWNLOAD ONLY ONE OF THE FOLLOWING! 
[/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone Continued[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url]

Installation: 
1: You HAVE to delete all previous folders if reinstalling!
2: This mod requires SMAPI and content patcher, so make sure you have both installed to the specifications listed on their pages. 
3: Make sure that both Lucikiel and whichever Mobile Phone Version you are installed to the standards listed on their individual pages (including all required mods for them)
4: Either download Lucikiel for Mobile Phone via your mod manager, or manually
﻿a: If you do it via manager that should be it, please enjoy the mod and let me know if you run into any issues! I will do my best to sort them out. 
﻿b: If you do it manually, then manually extract the file into your mod folder, then you should be ready to go!

There is a config file, the only thing it does is turns the adjusted greetings and goodbyes on or off. I'm hoping to expand upon it more as I have more time. 

Thanks again, and please enjoy the mod. :)
